description: Translate English to Pig Latin and back, with proper vowel, consonant-cluster and 'qu' rules plus case handling.

faqs.a: Words starting with a vowel get 'way' added (apple → appleway). Consonant clusters move to the end with 'ay' (string → ingstray). 'qu' moves together (queen → eenquay).
Yes — capitalization and punctuation are preserved, so 'Hello, world!' becomes 'Ellohay, orldway!'.
faqs.q: Does it keep capitalization and punctuation?

faqs.a: Decoding reverses the process but cannot always recover the original word, since multiple English words can map to the same Pig Latin form.

howto: Choose English → Pig Latin or Pig Latin → English.
title: Pig Latin Translator
